hypotheses.mechanism: The current G9 V3 surface language is not closed under its declared EBNF because current source constructs are absent or underspecified in the grammar.
hypotheses.expected: Exact current source fragments using comparisons, if, line comments and legacy predicate forms fail under a parser proxy faithful to the declared grammar.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The apparent mismatch is only cosmetic documentation drift and does not affect executable parsing.
hypotheses.falsifier: A parser generated from the current declared EBNF parses the exact tested current-G9 fragments and whole current G9 source without hidden extensions.

hypotheses.mechanism: A minimal compatibility grammar can close the observed surface gap without changing ClayCode cognitive semantics.
hypotheses.expected: Adding comments, comparison operators, conditional syntax, explicit executable precedence and bounded legacy predicates parses the targeted current fragments.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The surface mismatch reflects deeper semantic ambiguity that cannot be repaired without redesigning the language.
hypotheses.falsifier: Whole-file parsing/canonical roundtrip exposes irreducible ambiguities or meaning-changing parses under the minimal candidate.

hypotheses.mechanism: Separating declarative rule expressions from executable runtime expressions allows compatibility with current semantic prose-like predicates while keeping executable code deterministic and precedence-defined.
hypotheses.expected: Whole G9 can canonicalize legacy rule predicates into typed relation nodes while runtime expressions remain unambiguous.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: One unified expression grammar is simpler and equally safe if all operators are declared centrally.
hypotheses.falsifier: A unified typed operator table yields equal deterministic roundtrip, diagnostics and fuzz robustness with lower complexity.
hypotheses.next_test: whole-file parse + deterministic canonical roundtrip + mutation corpus

hypotheses.mechanism: A WIT-like typed import/export boundary combined with capability-scoped host access can serve ClayCode Ubuntu FFI/lowering without moving authority into model text.
hypotheses.expected: APP-01..APP-10 can use explicit typed adapters and capabilities with stable receipts and no ambient authority.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Direct native Ubuntu ABI/FFI is simpler and more performant with equivalent safety under a host gateway.
hypotheses.falsifier: Ubuntu benchmarks show WASM/WASI-style boundaries materially worsen coverage/latency/debuggability or add no containment/audit benefit.
hypotheses.next_test: native-vs-WASM/WASI microbenchmarks and APP-08 authority-bypass tests

hypotheses.mechanism: Existing record/tensor/intervention/receipt primitives can represent the LoopDynamicsReadout/controller contract without adding new core syntax.
hypotheses.expected: Minimal loop readout + continue/halt/escalate + lesion/rescue + rollback program parses, type-checks and executes after parser closure.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Loop semantics require first-class language primitives beyond generic records/rules.
hypotheses.falsifier: A concrete loop program cannot preserve required identity/timescale/intervention semantics through current typed IR/lowering without opaque escape hatches.
hypotheses.next_test: compile minimal LoopDynamicsReadout contract on Ubuntu target
